attacks.claim: The offline expiry check only catches a device clock set earlier than the download time. A clock that is wrong but still later than the download time, or set back within the download-to-valid_until window, will show an expired forecast as current in the field. This breaks the agreed rule that the app must never present stale safety information as current.
attacks.evidence: "The expiry rule above applies on-device using device time, so an offline phone in the field shows 'Forecast expired' once `valid_until` passes. The app also stores the server time at download; if the device clock reads earlier than that, the stored forecast is treated as expired." QA only tests "Device clock moved earlier than offline download time", not a clock drifting to any time between download and `valid_until` while the real time is already past it.
